items.title: The end of Microsoft Research's AI Frontiers group
items.title_zh: 微软研究院 AI Frontiers 团队宣告终结，John Langford 离职
items.title_en: Microsoft Research's AI Frontiers Group Shut Down as John Langford Exits
items.summary: Microsoft Research's AI Frontiers group has been shut down, prompting discussion about the industry-wide narrowing of exploratory AI research in favor of transformer scaling.

items.title: MaxxBench – "Nice DeepSWE score. But is it true?"
items.title_zh: MaxxBench 质疑高分 DeepSWE 成绩是否反映真实编码能力
items.title_en: MaxxBench questions whether high DeepSWE scores reflect real coding ability
items.summary: MaxxBench examines whether high DeepSWE scores reflect real capability or benchmark overfitting, arguing labs' RL environments are too similar to eval tasks and that smaller models degrade most.

items.title: Every Mac comes with an (undocumented) family member classifier
items.title_zh: 研究者发现每台 Mac 上都有未公开的 Apple 后台进程在构建个人知识图谱
items.title_en: Researcher finds undocumented Apple daemons building a personal knowledge graph on every Mac
items.summary: The author documents undocumented Apple daemons shipping on Macs since 2022 that construct an on-device personal knowledge graph mapping users, their contacts, relationships, communications, and movements.

items.title: We Visited China’s Stargate in Inner Mongolia
items.title_zh: SemiAnalysis 探访内蒙古 800MW 风电 AI 数据中心园区
items.title_en: SemiAnalysis Visits 800MW Wind-Powered AI Campus in Inner Mongolia
items.summary: A visit to a wind-powered 800MW AI datacenter campus in Inner Mongolia reveals rapid construction, a 5MW 800V DC solid-state-transformer pilot, and a cooling design without central chillers.

items.title: 🐧 甲骨文取消与腾讯 70 亿美元芯片租赁协议  甲骨文取消了与腾讯价值约 70 亿美元的 AI 芯片租赁协议。
items.title_zh: 甲骨文在美方压力下取消与腾讯 70 亿美元 AI 芯片租赁协议
items.title_en: Oracle Scraps $7B AI Chip Lease Deal With Tencent Under US Pressure
items.summary: Oracle reportedly canceled a roughly $7 billion AI chip leasing agreement with Tencent after US officials raised concerns, affecting Tencent's planned access to about 100,000 advanced AI chips via Southeast Asian data centers.

items.title: 苹果披露人形机器人系统 HALO，用两个千问模型
items.title_zh: 苹果披露人形机器人系统HALO，采用两个千问模型
items.title_en: Apple Unveils HALO Humanoid Robot Control System Powered by Two Qwen Models
items.summary: Apple's research team disclosed HALO, a three-layer humanoid robot autonomous control system using two Qwen models that transfers simulated motions to real-world rooms on a Unitree G1.

items.title: GitHub 新架构支持每秒 7200 次推送
items.title_zh: GitHub 新架构 Rubicon 每秒可处理 7200 次推送
items.title_en: GitHub's Rubicon architecture handles 7,200 pushes per second
items.summary: GitHub introduced a new Git storage architecture codenamed Rubicon that supports 5,000 concurrent AI agents and 7,200 pushes per second by using Azure Blob Storage, Ref-CAS, virtual replicas, and background pack compaction.
